items.prompt: For P(B)>0, which denominator defines P(A|B)?

options.text: P(A), because A is written first
options.why: That denominator belongs to the reverse conditional.

options.text: P(B), the event being conditioned on

options.why: The union is not the conditioning region.
The marginal probability of B still matters.

items.explanation: The ratio is joint mass P(A∩B) divided by P(B), with a positive denominator.
